Prerequisite: Reachable RADIUS or TACACS+ servers, each with a unique shared secret
What it enables: Remote administrator authentication, 802.1X and MAB, and RADIUS accounting
How to put it in place: An organization RADIUS or TACACS+ service, then config user radius; edit <RADIUS_1>; set server <RADIUS_1_IP>; set secret <KEY_1>; end or config user tacacs+; edit <TACACS_1>; set server <TACACS_1_IP>; set key <KEY_1>; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config user radius and config user tacacs+; Chapter 11 rows *RADIUS for administrative authentication* and *TACACS+ for administrative authentication*

Prerequisite: User group that lists the authentication servers
What it enables: The administrator remote group (remote-group) and the 802.1X security group (security-groups)
How to put it in place: config user group; edit <GROUP>; set member <RADIUS_1> <RADIUS_2>; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config user group, config system admin, and config switch interface (port-security); Chapter 11 rows *802.1X port mode* and *802.1X MAC-based mode*

Prerequisite: PKI: the DoD CA certificate on the switch, and a reachable CA enrollment (SCEP) service
What it enables: Certificate enrollment from the DoD CA and RadSec server certificate validation
How to put it in place: config system certificate ca; edit <DOD_CA>; set ca <CA_CERTIFICATE>; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config system certificate ca, config system certificate local (scep-url), and config user radius (radsec-server-ca-cert, radsec-cert-validate); Chapter 11 row *802.1X: RadSec (IPv4)*

Prerequisite: Central syslog servers that accept reliable (TCP) syslog with TLS
What it enables: Off-loading logs to two central servers with reliable, encrypted delivery
How to put it in place: Two organization log servers, then config log syslogd setting; set status enable; set server <SYSLOG_SERVER_1>; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config log {syslogd, syslogd2, syslogd3} setting (mode, enc-algorithm); Chapter 11 row *Reliable syslog*

Prerequisite: Authoritative NTP servers and their authentication keys
What it enables: Synchronized, authenticated time for log time stamps, and key lifetimes for routing protocol keys
How to put it in place: Organization NTP servers, then config system ntp; config ntpserver; edit 1; set server <NTP_SERVER_1>; set authentication enable; set key-id <ID>; set key <KEY>; end; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config system ntp; Chapter 11 row *NTP server (IPv4/IPv6)*

Prerequisite: SNMPv3 manager configured with the same user, authentication, and privacy settings
What it enables: SNMPv3 queries and notifications with SHA-2 authentication and AES privacy
How to put it in place: The organization network management system, then config system snmp user; edit <USER>; set notify-hosts <NMS_IP>; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config system snmp user

Prerequisite: A FortiGate managing the switch over FortiLink
What it enables: The "FortiGate:" commands and the Security Fabric features (NAC, quarantine, centralized syslog collection)
How to put it in place: FortiGate: config system interface; edit <FORTILINK>; set fortilink enable; end
Source: *Feature Matrix for FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0* (Security Fabric features are available only in managed mode); FortiOS 8.0.1 CLI Reference, config system interface

What it enables: Policy-based routing, VRF, OSPF, RIP, VRRP, BGP, IS-IS, PIM-SSM, and VXLAN BGP EVPN, and router event logs
How to put it in place: execute license add <LICENSE_KEY>, then check with execute license status
Source: *Feature Matrix for FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0*, section "Layer 3: Requires Advanced Features License" and note 19; FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference notes under config router ospf, config router rip, config router route-map, and get log eventfilter

Prerequisite: A switch model series that supports the feature
What it enables: Features the feature matrix marks as not supported on some model series (for example uRPF, IP source guard, dynamic ARP inspection, FIPS-CC mode, and the licensed Layer 3 features)
How to put it in place: Check the model series column of the feature matrix for your release; get system status shows the model
Source: *Feature Matrix for FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0* (PDF), model-series columns; the first (GUI) column is not a model series

Prerequisite: A management interface with an address: the management port or a management SVI on a dedicated VLAN
What it enables: Restricting management protocols to the management network, and keeping management off the default VLAN
How to put it in place: config system interface; edit <MGMT_SVI>; set interface internal; set vlanid <MGMT_VLAN>; set ip <IP_ADDRESS> <MASK>; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config system interface; Chapter 11 row *SVI*

Prerequisite: Routing protocol configured with its neighbors, and matching keys on every peer
What it enables: Neighbor authentication, TTL security, prefix and AS path filters, and maximum prefixes
How to put it in place: config router bgp; set as <ASN>; set router-id <ROUTER_ID>; config neighbor; edit <PEER_IP>; set remote-as <PEER_ASN>; end; end, with the same key or key chain configured on each peer
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config router bgp, config router ospf, and config router key-chain

Prerequisite: DHCP snooping enabled on the VLAN
What it enables: Dynamic ARP inspection, which can be enabled only on a VLAN with DHCP snooping enabled
How to put it in place: config switch vlan; edit <VLAN>; set dhcp-snooping enable; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config switch vlan (note under arp-inspection)

Prerequisite: The user, native, management, and unused VLANs created on the switch
What it enables: Per-VLAN settings (DHCP snooping, ARP inspection, IGMP and MLD snooping) and native VLAN assignments
How to put it in place: config switch vlan; edit <VLAN_ID>; set description <VLAN_NAME>; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config switch vlan and config switch interface (native-vlan, allowed-vlans)

Prerequisite: IP-to-MAC binding entries for statically addressed hosts
What it enables: IP source guard on ports with hosts that do not use DHCP
How to put it in place: config switch ip-source-guard; edit <PORT>; config binding-entry; edit 1; set ip <IP_ADDRESS>; set mac <MAC_ADDRESS>; end; end
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, config switch ip-source-guard

Prerequisite: An SFTP server and account for configuration backups
What it enables: The automation stitch that copies the configuration off the switch when it changes
How to put it in place: An organization SFTP server; the backup runs execute backup config sftp <FILE> <SFTP_SERVER> <USER> <PASSWORD>
Source: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI Reference, execute backup config and config system automation-action
